objective: Validate the aerodynamic CFD workflow before using it for rocket optimization.
decision: Do not use this CFD workflow or any retained CFD coefficient for rocket optimization or flight prediction.

evidence: Earlier approximate-model reduced-domain failures remain under runs/cfd-tmr-naca0012-897x233-a0-sstm-*force-audit-failed*.

evidence.finding: Analytic controls and NACA force conventions were audited, but the non-authoritative finned rocket surface remains asymmetric and the exact current-review rocket geometry is absent.

benchmarks_and_tolerances_predeclared.evidence: NASA TMR flat plate and altered closed NACA 0012 benchmarks, matched experimental conditions, and uncertainty-based tolerances are recorded in cfd/validation-plan.json.

wall_and_turbulence_subsystem.limitation: This does not validate external-body pressure drag, separation, fins, or a rocket.

external_body_numerical_behavior.finding: Corrected-model iterative, finest-pair grid, LUST scheme, and y-plus checks pass; the predeclared reduced-domain energy-residual gate fails at 2.098e-5 versus 1e-5.

external_body_benchmark_agreement.finding: Absolute Cd discrepancy 0.00067624 exceeds conservative allowance 0.00043868 by 0.00023756 even when the full domain budget is granted.

automated_integrity_and_physics_checks.evidence: Case construction, immutable field mapping, runtime/image checks, force/residual/temperature/symmetry audits, y-plus, pressure, skin friction, grid, scheme, and acceptance checks are executable scripts with passing tests.

conventional_rocket_openrocket_compariso.reason: Blocked by failed external-body numerical and benchmark gates. No CFD coefficient was transferred.

novel_fin_ranking.reason: Blocked by prior gates; no ring-tail aerodynamic benefit is claimed.

terminal_condition: The declared workflow has been evaluated and rejected. Further solver or boundary-condition remediation is a new predeclared validation campaign, not permission to use current coefficients.
